brief:
Egyptian-American surgeon Adam Hamawy won election to Congress from New Jersey's 12th congressional district, Middle East Eye reported. Hamawy, who conducted medical missions to Gaza, will join the incoming Democratic majority in the House of Representatives following the recent midterm elections.

The victory marks a historic moment for Hamawy's candidacy, though additional details about his platform and campaign remain unavailable from the provided summary.

title: Egyptian-American surgeon wins New Jersey House seat
